name: whiskers
description: A tiny status line by the prompt: model, effort, usage limits, spending pace, and context

position.title: Position
position.description: above: a coloured line just above the prompt. below: a dim line after the hint under the prompt.

showUsage.title: Show usage limits
showUsage.description: 📊 How much of your usage limits is used

showBurnRate.title: Show burn rate
showBurnRate.description: ↗ How fast the 5 hour limit fills, when it is moving

showTokens.title: Show token pace
showTokens.description: 🧶 Tokens spent this minute, with 🔥 or 🙀 when the pace would hit your 5 hour limit

showTokenChart.title: Show token chart
showTokenChart.description: ▁▃▅ Bars for the last 8 minutes next to the token pace

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: 🧠 How full the context window is

showEdits.title: Show edits
showEdits.description: 🐾 Files and lines changed this prompt (needs Pawprints)

sendLimits.title: Send limits to Pawprints
sendLimits.description: When Pawprints is installed, store each usage-limit reading so its web view can chart your 5 hour and weekly limits over time. Nothing leaves this machine.
